post.caption: Kokichi Mikimoto was born in 1858 in Toba, Japan, where his family ran an udon noodle shop. In 1893 he made the world's first half round cultured pearls on the island now called Pearl Island, and he got a patent for round pearls in 1916. Only about 5 percent of harvested oysters give perfect pearls, and he wanted pearls around the neck of every woman.
